Name: Magic Portal Doors for PIF
Author: Rvkito
Description:
Adds a Magic Book Catalogue  that can be bought by Robin the  carpender or the PIFshop in the tunnel.

Inside are a Portals, Fireplaces, Crystal Balls, Brooms (with Catalogue) that act like doors for PIF.  
Also some Catalouges with doors and a lift with numbers on it from 00 -99



For the Portals and Doors to actually work, you need the mod  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]  and also additional rooms for it like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28199]Aimon's Farmhouse Rooms (PIF)[/url].

Animations are added with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]. Without it there won't be any animation.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] adds the Catalouges for this mod. Without it you would need something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] to find the PIFdoors.
